استوحيتم (form X)
# اِسْتَوْحَيْتُمْ (istawḥaytum) /is.taw.ħaj.tum/: second-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَوْحَى (istawḥā)
# اُسْتُوحِيتُمْ (ustūḥītum) /us.tuː.ħiː.tum/: second-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَوْحَى (istawḥā)
